title: City station readings (hourly)
summary: Hourly NO2 and PM2.5 readings from Valdena's own urban monitoring stations, starting 2023-01-01 and still updating hourly. Four columns: station_id, ts_utc, no2_ugm3 and pm25_ugm3. Covers ~4.2M rows from the city's fixed monitoring network. Covers the production window (2024-2025) but NOT the prototype window (2004-2005). Station VR-03 (Via Roma) was switched off on 2024-06-30 — readings for that station stop there. Access requires a request to the Environment Monitoring Unit.

Temporal coverage starts 2023-01-01, does NOT cover the prototype window (2004-2005).
Approx 4.2M rows suggests about ~480 rows per hour over ~3.8 years for the full network. Exact number of stations is not documented in the catalog entry.
